chunks: And Fadl narrated, from Ali ibn Asbat, from Muhammad ibn Abi al-Bilad, from Ali ibn Muhammad al-Awdi, from his father, from his grandfather, who said:

Amir al-Mu'minin (peace be upon him) said: Before the Qaim, there will be red death and white death, and locusts at their proper time and locusts at an improper time, red like the colors of blood. As for the red death, it is the sword; and as for the white death, it is the plague.
ai.seo_question: What are the signs of red and white death before the reappearance of Imam Mahdi?
ai.summary: In this narration from *Kitab al-Ghayba*, Imam Ali (a.s.) outlines catastrophic pre-occultation signs, interpreting 'red death' as war and 'white death' as plague, while highlighting the abnormal timing of locust swarms as a disruption of natural order. This description aligns with Shia eschatological tradition, emphasizing that these tribulations serve as divine purification before the emergence of the Qa'im. The imagery reflects the cosmic upheaval anticipated in the final days of the Minor and Major Ghaiba.

en.sayyid-athar-husain-s-h-rizvi: H 430 - It is narrated from Fadhl from Ali bin Asbat from Muhammad bin Abi Bilad from Ali bin Muhammad Awdi from his father from his grandfather that

Amirul Momineen (a.s) said: “Before the Qaim, there will be red death and white death; there will be locusts at their usual time and at their unusual time like the colors of blood. As for red death it is (from) the sword, while the white death is (from) plague.”
